title: Productivity and decline of Parliament
quote: 135 sitting days a year in the 1st Lok Sabha → about 55 in the 17th

boxes.title: Sitting days
items: Lok Sabha **60-70 days** vs **150+** in UK House of Commons
Question Hour (17th LS) ran only **60%** of scheduled time
**Art. 85(1)**: only bars a gap of more than **six months**; ==**no minimum** sitting days==

boxes.title: Weak scrutiny & bypass routes
items: 17th LS: **58%** Bills passed within **two weeks**; **35%** debated **< one hour**
UK: every Bill examined by committees; India: DRSCs only from ==**1993**==
**Ordinances (Art. 123)** + delegated legislation
**Money Bill route (Art. 110)** bypasses RS, e.g. ==**Aadhaar Act, 2016**==
Farm Laws (**2020**) cited as hasty law-making

head: Rule
House
Effect

boxes.title: Leader of Opposition
items: First formally recognised: ==**1969**==
Largest opposition party with **10%** of House = about **55 seats** in LS
Statute: **Salary and Allowances of Leaders of Opposition in Parliament Act, 1977**
Tools: Question Hour, motions, **PAC** chaired by Opposition since **1967**
Monsoon 2026: **FCRA (Amendment) Bill, 2026** pushed to JPC

cards.title: Other proposals
lines: Whips only for **confidence votes & Money Bills**

boxes.title: States & current
items: PRS 2025: Assemblies met avg ==**24 days**== (Odisha **43**, Nagaland **7**)
Many met only to satisfy **Art. 174**; **600+** bills, **33%** in one sitting
AP Budget Session 2026: **11 Feb - 7 Mar**
**86th AIPOC**, **Lucknow**: "Strong Legislature - Prosperous Nation"; AIPOC since **1921**
131st Amendment Bill: LS **550 → 850**; LS:RS **2.2:1 → 3.3:1**; joint sittings only **3 times**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: **60%** = Bills referred (14th LS) and Question Hour run (17th LS); **16%** = referred (17th)
==**Art. 85(1)**== = Parliament gap; **Art. 174** = States gap
**374A** = automatic suspension, **5 sittings**
